restoreNotes: Use supported Pencil MCP APIs to restore into the correct document; never treat this JSON as a .pen file.
selectedNodes contains G81ak both separately and nested in kvTdT. Restore each node once, retaining a mapping from saved IDs to newly created IDs.
Preserve unchanged business artboards. Reconcile selected artboards by their saved IDs/names; inspect the current canvas first.
Insert/Replace APIs generate new IDs. Remap every ref and descendants key when nodes or components are recreated; update current-design.json when IDs change.
dependencyNodes contains the exact unchanged component dependencies needed by captured artboards; reuse existing matching dependencies when available.
No new reusable components or variables were introduced. Images remain relative to Saas.pen and use existing local design assets.
Verify references and exports, then perform native save and confirm disk metadata after Windows is unlocked.
